stem: (Select TWO.) Cinder Labs wants its pipeline to supply the HCP Terraform connection settings through environment variables. Which two statements are correct?

choices.text: `TF_WORKSPACE` creates the workspace during `terraform init` when it does not exist yet
`TF_CLOUD_HOSTNAME` has no default and has to be exported in every pipeline
An empty `cloud` block is still required when every setting comes from the environment
A value written in the `cloud` block takes precedence over the same setting in an environment variable
`TF_CLOUD_ORGANIZATION` also selects which workspace the directory uses

rationale: If everything is configured through environment variables, an empty `cloud` block must still be added to the configuration file, and when a setting is given in both places the configuration takes precedence. `TF_WORKSPACE` selects a workspace but does not create one; the workspace must already exist in the organization. The hostname argument defaults to app.terraform.io, so exporting `TF_CLOUD_HOSTNAME` matters mainly for Terraform Enterprise. `TF_CLOUD_ORGANIZATION` names the organization, and `TF_WORKSPACE` is the variable that selects the workspace.
